title: Chapter 200 The Xuan Sect Ancestor
content:
Chapter 200 The Xuan Sect Ancestor

Hearing Yan Lingyun's answer, Lu Daosheng nodded.

What he said is indeed very reasonable.

Which of the practitioners who can survive in the Central Domain has no background in strength?

The competitive pressure is absolutely terrifying.

Furthermore, although resources are abundant, they are limited after all.

In order to be able to get more resources, it is inevitable that Zhongyu will do such a thing.

Without further ado, Lu Daosheng and Yan Lingyun soon got back on track.

boom!

With Yan Lingyun's punch, she burst out.

The barrier of the immortal world that blocked countless practitioners directly broke through a hideous hole.

Whoosh ~

The two flew directly in.

And the next moment, the hole began to heal gradually.

At the same time, countless terrifying existences in the central domain woke up one after another, looking solemnly towards the direction of the boundary of the central domain.

"There is, Wood Fairy Realm!"

Suddenly, countless strong men were shocked.

There is such a strong man in the Wood Fairy World!

Central province.

"Hmm? Why did I suddenly have a bad feeling?"

In a quaint attic, an old man suddenly woke up from his cultivation, with a serious expression.

"Is something wrong with Xuanzong?"

The old man murmured to himself, but then shook his head.

If something happened to Xuanzong, he would definitely receive the news, not to mention, what about Xuanzong and him now.

Let's talk about it if you can keep yourself.

And just then, a servant suddenly ran up.

"Shopkeeper, two guests came downstairs and said they had something to come to you."

Hearing this, the old man frowned slightly.

Someone is looking for him?

I have all gone to the Central Region, and anyone else recognizes me?

"Then do you have the identity of the person who comes?"

The old man asked.

"No, the shopkeeper, just a man and a woman, she looks quite young, and she is still a Taoist couple."

Hearing this, the old man quickly recalled it, but he got nothing.

There is no character about a young Taoist couple in my memory.

Probably, I was thinking too much.

Immediately, the old man slowly stood up.

At this time, downstairs, the loose guests were drinking tea downstairs, looking a little deserted.

At the window, a handsome man and beautiful woman were sitting opposite each other, slowly tasting the tea.

"The tea is a bit average."

Yan Lingyun took a sip and put down the teacup directly.

Lu Daosheng nodded slightly.

"It's true, it seems that I'm reluctant to get the good goods."

At this time, a group of tall and strong men, with great hostility, suddenly rushed into the hall, and then their eyes were directly on Yan Lingyun, who was sitting by the bed.

When they saw Yan Lingyun, the group looked very happy.

"Young master, that woman!"

Immediately, surrounded by this group of people, a young man in a luxurious dress slowly walked into the teahouse with a feather fan.

Seeing Yan Lingyun, the young man's expression suddenly lit up.

"I didn't expect that there was such a top-notch in the city. I'm really lucky."

Immediately, the man quickly walked to Yan Lingyun's side.

"Miss, Mo Ren, the son of the lord of the Heilin City in Xiaxia, I wonder if I can get to know him?"

Mo Ren looked at Yan Lingyun who was so delicate and speechless in front of him, and showed a kind smile, directly ignoring Lu Daosheng next to him.

However, Yan Lingyun did not raise her eyebrows to look at him from beginning to end.

At this time, Lu Daosheng spoke.

"You know,"

As soon as he spoke, Mo Ren's face changed, and he suddenly turned his head and shouted angrily: "Who are you? I'm talking to the girl, why are you making a fuss!?"

"Come on, get this kid out for me and beat him to death."

After saying that, Mo Ren looked at Yan Lingyun again, his face still so kind.

"Don't worry, girl, no one can disturb us."

"Of course, it doesn't matter if you don't want to know me, but the girl may suffer a little bit of flesh and blood."

As he said that, Mo Ren reached out and touched Yan Lingyun's jade hand, wanting to kiss her.

Obviously, this is not the first time Mo Ren has done such a thing as bullying men and dominating women, and he is very familiar with it.

And just as Mo Ren was about to touch Yan Lingyun's jade hand, a breeze blew by.

The next moment, a scream rang out.

"ah!!!"

"My hand, my hand!!"

I saw that Mo Ren's hand was suddenly cut off by Qi Gen and fell directly to the ground.

"Young Master!!"

Everyone hurriedly surrounded him and looked at Mo Ren's broken hand in horror.

They didn't even see who did it.

At the same time, the only few remaining guests in the teahouse also quickly ran away.

"Who did it!"

After Mo Ren reacted, his face turned ferocious and he roared directly.

"I did it."

At this time, Lu Daosheng suddenly said.

Suddenly, Mo Ren and others looked at Lu Daosheng.

"It's you boy, you, you're so brave!"

Mo Ren subconsciously took a step back. Since the opponent's move was so weird, he was obviously not a weak person.

However, I am not easy to mess with.

"Do you know who my dad is?"

"Do you know who my brother is?"

Mo Ren asked for two straight questions, but Lu Daosheng shook his head.

"It doesn't matter who it is, what's important is that you messed with the wrong person."

Immediately, Lu Daosheng's body suddenly shook.

Suddenly, Mo Ren and others were stunned.

At this time, Lu Daosheng looked at the stairs with a cold look.

"Aren't you coming out yet?"

The sound fell, and in a moment, an old man gradually appeared.

"You are really a good method to solidify time and space."

The old man looked at Lu Daosheng with a serious expression.

Seeing the old man, Lu Daosheng didn't say much and directly reached out to Lu Daosheng.

Suddenly, the powerful air pressure directly crushed the old man.

In just a moment, the old man couldn't hold on and knelt on the ground with a bang.

"You, you,"

The old man supported the ground with his palms, and was extremely frightened.

What kind of terrifying existence is this? As a strong man in the late stage of the Immortal Emperor Realm, he has no power to fight back in the other party.

"Old ancestor Xuanzong, you escaped quite quickly."

At this time, Lu Daosheng suddenly said.

The old man was the ancestor of Xuanzong and one of the nine emperors of that year.

The old man was extremely cautious. As early as the Crazy Emperor had just broken the seal and was reborn from the world, he chose to leave the sect and run away.

The leader of the Xuanzong Sect at that time followed closely.

But as a result, no matter how far I ran, what should come was still here.

Hearing that his identity was exposed by the terrifying existence in front of him, the ancestor Xuanzong felt a lot cold.

"I wonder how this senior has offended you?"

Facing Lu Daosheng, the ancestor of Xuanzong had no strength to fight back and had to speak hard.

At this time, Yan Lingyun, who had been silent on the side, stood up.

"The Crazy Emperor you sealed back then is my apprentice."

As soon as these words came out, the ancestor of Xuanzong suddenly smiled bitterly.

Since that year, he has regretted the siege of the Crazy Emperor.

Why did you go to that muddy water?

At the beginning, even if no one took action to stop the Crazy Emperor, the Heavenly Dao would not be able to bear it and would be suppressed.

But I just made a fame and fortune.

As a result, I was injured, not only did I not improve my cultivation, but my power development was affected.

Then he was forced to flee here to survive.

Now it's even worse, I'm caught escaping here.

The old ancestor Xuanzong's face is even worse than crying now, he regrets it.
